title: Jewel Toned Chinese Mars Bar Wonton Soup
description: A sweet and velvety Chinese dessert soup featuring Mars bars, served in a romantic wonton style, this dish is a unique twist on traditional Chinese desserts, and is kosher friendly.
instructions: In a large pot, heat the oil over medium heat and add the sliced ginger to infuse the oil.
Add the brewed green tea, sugar, and water to the pot and bring to a simmer.
While the tea is simmering, prepare the wontons by placing a piece of chopped Mars bar in the center of each wrapper.
Dip your finger in water and run it along the edges of the wrapper to help seal the wonton.
Fold the wrapper into a triangle by bringing the two opposite corners together to form a point.
Press the edges together to seal the wonton.
Once all the wontons are prepared, add them to the simmering tea and cook for 5 minutes.
Serve the wontons in bowls and spoon some of the sweet tea over the top.
